description: SpecReview: deny Write calls that would rewrite most of a spec under review (use Edit instead), and surface submitted reviews that no background wait picked up. Every hook prints nothing on error and exits 0, so Claude Code's own prompt still works. The plan-mode gate is opt-in and not part of the plugin: `specreview install claude --with-plan-gate` adds it to settings.json (or copy the hook that `specreview plan-gate --help` prints).
